1
Abutalib Di Musalmanaa Ne Lut Layi Aye Kul Kamai.
Aidha Jurm Rasool Nu Palna Si Aidhay Lal Ali De Sir Te Taiyon Lokaan Zarb Chalai.
Imran Ne Zul-e-Ashira Te Dita Sath Rasool Da Taiyon.
Kul Khalqat Shehar Madine Di Rayi Haal Ali Da Takdi Rasiyaan Churwan Na Aayi.

2
Ag Shaib-e-Abu Talib Di Si Lokaan De Dil Te Tari.
Makay Da Wair Kamawan Layi Ag Pak Batool De Bohe Lokaan Ne Aan Lagai.
Kabay Wich Was Na Chaliya Te Masjid Kofay Wich Lokaan Pehli Sarkar Muhammad De.
Haq Hon Di Pak Gawahi Sajday Wich Maar Mukai.

3
Oh Dard Rasool Da Wandda Si Odhi Aal Da Dukh Na Wandhiya.
Koi Pursa Dain Te Ki Aandha Gal Lag Lag Kofay Andar Lokaan Ne EID Manai.
 Akbar Aye Chothay Kalmago Imran Nu Aakhan Kafir.
Jidhay Putraan Dhiyaan Karbal Wich Te Sham De Moraan Utay Diti Rab Di Pak Gawai

from pathlib import Path
import re, subprocess
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/abutalib-di-musalmanaa-ne-lut-layi-aye-lyrics-2019-tajpoints-871789679a623b565b3e.md')
old = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'HEAD:{p}'], text=True).split('---', 2)[2]
_, yaml, body = p.read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = yaml.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
blocks = lambda s: [b.splitlines() for b in re.split(r'\\n\\s*\\n', s.strip())]
normalize = lambda s: s.strip().lower().rstrip('.')
assert list(map(normalize, old.splitlines()))[2:] or old
assert [[normalize(l) for l in b] for b in blocks(old)] == [[normalize(l) for l in b] for b in blocks(roman)]
assert [(b[0], len(b)-1) for b in blocks(body)] == [('۱',4), ('۲',4), ('۳',4)]
print('Roman wording preserved and 12 source verses aligned across three stanzas.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed all 12 verses in Shahmukhi Punjabi and verified that the source and `romanLyrics` align across all three stanzas. The verse grammar supports Punjabi, so I corrected the Urdu metadata and removed `noUrdu`. Only the selected lyric changed.

I read the ambiguous Roman `Shaib` as شعبِ and `Zul-e-Ashira` as ذوالعشیرہ.
